description: Price a rental the way EvaFarm bills it: per active minute, rounded up, no minimum; node preparation is not billed. Give a duration (hours and/or minutes) or a render (frames × seconds_per_frame measured on that kind of node). With a node label the estimate uses its rate; without one it prices every hardware configuration in the catalog. nodes_count > 1 splits the frames evenly across that many identical nodes.

hours.description: Rental duration in hours (may be combined with minutes).

node.description: Node label to price, e.g. "NODE_03". Omit to compare all configurations.

nodes_count.description: Identical nodes rendering in parallel. Default 1.

seconds_per_frame.description: Render time of one frame on that node, in seconds.

name: estimate_cost
title: Estimate rental cost
